hook_text: Some history is not written in any book. It is stored in your grandfather's memory.
clip_script: A village near Thohoyandou, Limpopo. Mulalo sits down with her grandfather, a notebook and five questions. When you were my age, how did you get to town? He laughs. On foot, all day! Then he remembers the first bus that came to the village, and how everyone ran to see it. That is oral history. Plan your questions, ask politely, listen carefully, write it down, and say thank you. Every elder is a library.
visual_style: Whiteboard of a grandfather speaking, with speech bubbles turning into drawings: a dusty road, a herd of cattle, an old bus.
mood: Gentle and respectful, with a smile.
pacing: The question, the memory, then the five steps of a good interview.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan three questions to ask an elder in your family.
